channel.title: Kenya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Kenya, every source cited.

item.title: Saudi Arabia bans travel from Kenya over Ebola fears
item.description: The kingdom suspended citizen travel and halted all visa issuances due to nine confirmed cases.

item.title: IEBC defends CEO shortlist over foreign applicants
item.description: The electoral commission states all shortlisted candidates for Chief Executive Officer are Kenyan citizens.

item.title: First body recovered from Nairobi building collapse
item.description: 16 people remain missing after an 18-storey building collapsed in Nairobi's Eastleigh district.

item.title: Rai Group plans US$32 million sugar factory in Kenya
item.description: The new facility in Nandi County will process 1,500 tonnes of sugarcane daily, creating jobs and boosting local incomes.

item.title: Kenya develops national coffee flavour atlas
item.description: Around 500 samples from 34 counties will be analysed to document diverse coffee profiles for industry use.
